Use Rich's markup to print orange text, for example `rich.print("[orange1]text[/orange1]")`. `orange1` is in Rich's supported color palette. See [Console Markup](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/markup.rst) and [Styles](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/style.rst). For usage questions, ask on [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
